summary: Abandoned, But Not Forgotten is an interactive online museum focusing on the abandoned space missions and machines on the Moon, Mars and beyond. The project contains 10 different missions from the Moon and Mars. Each mission can be explored through 6 chapters using authentic historical photos, audio narration and captions. It also includes a Mission Academy which teaches you about space technology through 3 interactive games; Build Your Own Rover, Space Detective and Mission Control. It also includes a Space Quiz for you to test your knowledge on space missions. This project aims to make learning about space exploration more interesting and easier to understand. Rather than having to search multiple websites and documents for information, all of the information can be found in one place by using stories, games and quizzes. This project is important as it helps us to remember previous space missions, understand what they achieved and inspires people to learn more about science, technology and space exploration.
details:
Abandoned But Not Forgotten is a virtual museum that teaches people about old space missions and the equipment left behind in space. This website allows you to explore three different sections of missions: The Moon Archive, The Mars Archive and Beyond Space. There are ten different missions within the website, these missions can be explored with six different chapters: Birth, Journey, Mission, Discovery, Final Transmission and Legacy. You can view historical images, listen to a voiceover and read captions that are synced to the video. We have also created a Mission Academy with 3 fun games:

Build Your Own Rover: Design your own rover by choosing different parts.

Space Detective: Can you guess what mission it is?

Mission Control: Make decisions with your team as they try to complete a mission.

Benefits & Impact:-

This project has brought historical space information together into one resource. Using stories, images, games and quizzes has made learning more fun. Our aim was to help students and space lovers learn about previous missions and become interested in science, robotics and technology.

Tools & Technologies :-

We used multiple tools and technologies when creating this website. We used Next.js, React, TypeScript, JavaScript and Tailwind CSS. We also used some AI and digital tools like ChatGpt, antigravity.

Creativity:-

The idea is unique as it gives a fun way to show people what abandoned equipment there is in space by creating an interactive museum. Using cinematic stories and fun games and quizzes will keep people interested.

Considerations:-

We focused on making sure the information was historically accurate. We wanted to use real images and keep the website easy to navigate. We made our website easy to use and added educational elements. We also made sure the website was responsive and ran smoothly.
